facts.text: Our ride home on New Year's Eve.
facts.why: On New Year's Eve the Ghostbusters pilot the animated Statue of Liberty through the streets to the museum, so it is a ride to the museum, not home.
facts.fix: Our ride to the museum on New Year’s Eve.

vibe.verdict: A cheeky kids party menu that uses the birthday opening, mood slime and the Statue well, though the food is middling.
missing: The Scoleri brothers in court (the slime jar blows up)
Mood slime in a jar (Ray yelling at it)
'Higher and higher' in the museum (slime and the Statue)
Auld Lang Syne at midnight (the crowd beats Vigo)
ideas: Swap 'Pink slime float' for 'Mood slime sundae', which bubbles when you say rude things to it.
Swap the 'Don't look in the trap' tag for 'Do. Re. Egon.' on the Ray and Winston note.
Add 'Auld Lang Syne' as the line under the gelatin in place of 'It wobbles to music'.
Swap 'Mini bagel pizzas' for 'Scoleri brothers' hot seat salami', with a tiny electric chair picture.
